title: Hip Replacement System (HRS-P) in Primary Total Hip Arthroplasty
official: A Multi-Center Prospective Study of the Hip Innovation Technology (HIT) Hip Replacement System in Primary Total Hip Arthroplasty
summary: To evaluate effectiveness and safety of HHRS in subjects undergoing total hip arthroplasty (THA). Effectiveness will be evaluated using patient-reported, clinical, radiologic, and radiostereometric outcomes. Safety will be evaluated through the collection of device-related and unanticipated device-related adverse events.
